name: a missed jumper from the wing: the bigs box out, the defense's big takes it under the rim
the same miss: the offense's big beats the box-out for it
a miss off the glass from the left baseline, taken by the defense's big
a missed three from the top: a long rebound, caught by the guard at the free throw line
a missed corner three: it comes off the far side to the weak-side defender
three on three: every defender boxes out their man, the middle one takes it
a miss nobody gets to in the air: it bounces and the guard runs it down
a tight closeout on a jumper: the high hand up at the ball as it goes
a contested three: the closeout, the hand up toward the release
verticality at the rim: the big goes straight up with both hands at the ball
a layup blocked at the rim by the help big: the hand meets the ball, it is swatted away
a jumper blocked by the closeout: the hand up to the ball just after it leaves
a poke steal: the ball knocked loose off the dribble, the defender runs it down
a bad pass read and picked off in the lane
a reach-in on the dribbler: the hand at the ball, the whistle
